items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: George Gershwin wrote that song... Oh boy, you can’t beat George Gershwin.

ctx.x: George Gershwin wrote that song. Let me see if I remember. May I please? [Sol plays]. You ever hear that song?
It doesn’t sound familiar to me.
